audited_source_corrections.action: Grouped every rule and assumption branch under the sentence test in the definition of Correct.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Without grouping, standard precedence makes the Sent conjunct apply only to the first rule branch, although the following prose says the first line ensures every end-formula is a sentence.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வரையறை எல்லா விதிக் கிளைகளையும் எடுகோள் கிளையையும் வாக்கியச் சோதனையின் ஒரே அடைப்புக்குறிக்குள் வைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Leaving later rule and assumption branches outside the sentence condition; repeating Sent in every disjunct.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: One bracket pair implements exactly the scope stated in the explanatory sentence and preserves every individual rule test.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does Sent now constrain every Correct branch without changing the sixteen rule cases or the assumption case?

audited_source_corrections.action: Shifted the immediate-subderivation tuple lookup from slot j to slot j+1.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The tuple's slot 0 stores its arity; immediate subderivation codes occupy slots 1 through that arity. Indexing by j with j<arity includes the arity field and omits the last subderivation.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வரையறை உடனடி உட்வருவித்தல்களை அடுக்கின் 1 முதல் arity வரையிலான இடங்களிலிருந்து எடுக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Quantifying 1≤j≤arity with an additional bounded-range encoding; preserving the off-by-one lookup.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The coding definition at the start of the same section uniquely fixes the component positions.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected bounded lookup inspect every and only immediate subderivation component?

audited_source_corrections.action: Allowed implication introduction with discharge label 0 without constraining every open assumption to match its antecedent.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The coding definition assigns discharge label 0 when a rule discharges no assumptions. Applying Discharge(a,d,0) instead treats all label-0 open assumptions as one antecedent A and rejects valid vacuous implication introductions with unrelated open assumptions.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: விடுவிப்புச் சிட்டை 0 எனில் எந்த எடுகோளும் விடுவிக்கப்படவில்லை என்பதைத் தமிழ் வரையறை நேரடியாக ஒரு பிரிப்பிணைவுக் கிளையாக ஏற்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Forcing all undischarged assumptions to equal the conditional antecedent; forbidding vacuous discharge despite the coding clause.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The explicit meaning assigned to label 0 and the natural-deduction rule's permitted vacuous discharge determine the added branch.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the label-0 branch admit exactly the no-discharge case while retaining the label-matching test for positive labels?

audited_source_corrections.action: Made a label-0 assumption remain open regardless of the zero discharge marker carried by nondischarging ancestor rules.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The section defines label 0 both for an undischarged assumption and for an inference that discharges nothing. The unqualified inequality therefore misclassifies a label-0 assumption as discharged whenever its path crosses an ordinary nondischarging inference.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: எடுகோளின் சிட்டை 0 எனில் அது விடுவிக்கப்படாதது என்பதைத் தமிழ் வரையறை முதலில் ஏற்கிறது; நேர்மச் சிட்டைகளுக்கு மட்டுமே மூதாதை விடுவிப்புச் சிட்டையை ஒப்பிடுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Treating a nondischarging rule's zero marker as discharging every open assumption; replacing the entire path construction with a context-dependent code.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The two explicit uses of zero require a sentinel exception; all positive-label path behavior remains unchanged.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the added zero-label disjunct prevent false discharge while preserving the ancestor check for labeled assumptions?

audited_source_corrections.action: Wrapped the absent recursive-functions tree-coding section reference in oliflabeldef with a descriptive Tamil fallback; the live reference remains active when its label is present.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The standalone incompleteness-and-arithmetization reader omits the recursive-functions chapter that supplies the cited tree-coding section, which otherwise renders as an unresolved question mark.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: இலக்கு இருந்தால் நேரடி பிரிவு மேற்கோள்; இல்லையெனில் மரவுருக் குறியீடாக்கம் பற்றிய முந்தைய பிரிவு என்ற துல்லியமான தமிழ் விளக்கம்.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Literal question marks; deleting the coding dependency; permanently replacing the live section link.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The conditional fallback keeps the local proof-code explanation readable while preserving the exact reference identity for a cumulative reader.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the fallback identify exactly the tree-coding material used by SubtreeSeq without inventing a section number?
